title: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker
claim: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker — Diagnose RKN/TSPU internet blocks layer by layer (DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP)
why_good: The tool addresses a critical need for reliable internet access diagnostics in regions with heavy censorship, which is often overlooked.
value: Internet service providers and businesses in restricted regions could pay for a subscription service that offers detailed diagnostics and solutions to bypass blocks.
risk: The project could fail if larger tech companies implement similar features into their existing services, overshadowing this niche solution.
